The First Day of School: 开学第一天认识新朋友。
Today is Jack's first day at a new school. He is a little afraid because he knows nobody there.
In the classroom, the teacher asks Jack to sit next to a boy named Sam. Sam smiles and shows Jack his new pencils.
At break time, Sam teaches Jack to play a new ball game. Soon, other children join them. Jack is happy now. He is not afraid any more.
